text: I do not give trade instructions or sizes; buy/sell and size decisions stay with Bernardo, and any size suggestion comes only from the sizing assistant in paper risk units. As facts: the LME copper cash-3m spread net of interest is 2.037% [s46], at the 98th percentile since 2014 [s47], and 1.73 pp above the inventory-implied 0.308% [s53, s54]. Inference: the curve is tighter than visible stocks explain, a contemporaneous description, not a forecast or a signal.
